scientific_question: Can an unsuccessful pioneer leave a physical or social breeding-site legacy that increases subsequent neighborhood settlement even without successful chick production?
prior_art_beyond_which_novelty_is_requir: Penney 1968 small new-breeder attractive colonies with low success
Cox et al 2024 four nascent subcolonies at prior solitary site locations, including two where no active breeder was present
Historic penguin pebble nest mounds and guano-derived ornithogenic soils are known persistent island landscape features
Prospective age-dependent penguin dispersal and cohort effects described by Penney 1970 and Dugger et al 2026

alternative_hypotheses.H1_physical_legacy_without_success: Previously attempted but FAILED pioneer patch increases subsequent nearby first settlement relative to matched never-used patches when pre-season physical substrate is held comparable; candidate mechanism pebble nest structure/ornithogenic microterrain remains.
alternative_hypotheses.H2_social_success_only: Next first settlers preferentially use patches with PRIOR successful breeding, but failed pioneer patches have no residual advantage over never-used patches, consistent with successful reproductive public-information cues.
alternative_hypotheses.H3_static_habitat_sorting: Past failed and successful site classes are not predictive after accounting for measured pre-settlement shelter, dry gravel, slope, aspect, predator access, adjacent colony density and detection effort; same preferred physical patches are repeatedly selected.

primary_unit: independently identified 3–10 m breeding PATCH per austral breeding season; same fixed patch polygons across years, distinct from exact prior nest coordinate and named colony
prior_class_labels_fixed_before_future_s: prior observed breeding confirmed chicks at crèche
historical occupancy uncertain (excluded from primary test)

required_prediction_contrasts.failed_vs_never_used_under_H1: positive later FIRST breeding-attempt occupancy only after covariate matching, unexposed comparison; confidence interval excluding zero required for causal language
required_prediction_contrasts.successful_vs_failed_under_H2: successful-only cue contrast positive with failed vs never near zero
required_prediction_contrasts.all_prior_use_disappears_under_H3: all lagged class effects within prespecified negligible-effect range after measured substrate quality and true site availability, with adequacy/power check

minimum_data_gate: at least two independent island/colony sites and multiple reproductive years, not only Cox Cape Crozier 2021-2022
exact matched patch boundary and independent pre-settlement snow/ice-free rock access across years
early-season colonizer ID and first observed nesting attempt, with effort and detectability models
prior-year egg-to-crèche fate on SAME original patch; failure not inferred from absence of confirmation alone
clearly measured nest mound/rock/guano cues without disturbing wildlife
independent candidate-patch risk set including sites still never used, chosen BEFORE seeing settlement outcomes
disturbance or naturally varying microhabitat exposure measured before colony reoccupation, with credible unexposed comparisons
prefer marked breeders/offspring origins; otherwise explain inference is site selection only not immigrant rescue
prior_observational_dataset_status: Cox2024 50 original solitary GPS nest IDs with 3 originally nonbreeding source sites showing next-year near-neighbor counts, but no verified pioneer ID or random/exogenous source of old nest physical cue; hypothesis generated AFTER seeing data.
no_experiment_authorized: Do not remove/construct nests, redistribute guano or deploy decoys in Antarctica without applicable environmental and wildlife approvals. Current design uses existing observational natural patch changes.
forbidden: Never label 2021 nonbreeder site as a verified egg failure without prior detected egg
Do not claim an original nest was reused merely because a nearby n_neighbors count was positive
Do not call environmental preference or prior nest-site attraction a new result without independent counterfactual
Do not claim the 1968/2024 colonization observations are newly discovered
Do not fit the design using already outcome-exposed 36 Crozier original breeder sites as confirmatory independent events
Do not amend frozen PR189 or unlock frozen PR142
minimum_paper_claim_if_positive: Previous FAILED nesting attempts can facilitate subsequent nearby breeding settlement without prior breeding success by creating persistent patch-scale opportunity beyond static habitat and experienced breeder reoccupation.
null_or_habitat_only_outcome_means: No independent positive founder-legacy effect identified; must report null or HOLD, not switch to a new threshold/adjacency radius post hoc.
